To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the linear beam dynamics effects of insertion devices are determined by the magnetic fields of the magnet structures, which are derived in this work; (2) for a given insertion device, the linear beam dynamics is determined by the magnetic field of the magnet structure; (3) for a given magnet structure, the linear beam dynamical effects are determined by the parameters of the magnet structure.
